Whether you're planning a weekend away, or a long-haul holiday, the suitcase collection at Myer has you covered. Choose from [hard shell](https://www.myer.com.au/c/travel-tech/suitcases/hardside-suitcases) and [soft shell](https://www.myer.com.au/c/travel-tech/suitcases/softside-suitcases) options in [carry on](https://www.myer.com.au/c/travel-tech/suitcases/carry-on-bags), medium and large sizes from trusted travel brands like [Samsonite](https://www.myer.com.au/b/Samsonite), [American Tourister](https://www.myer.com.au/b/American%20Tourister), [Antler](https://www.myer.com.au/b/Antler) and [Delsey](https://www.myer.com.au/b/Delsey).
